title: Ribboned Courgette & Zesty Lemon Salad
steps: Using a Y-shaped peeler, ribbon the courgettes into long thin strips into a bowl.
Squeeze lemon juice over; toss gently.
Scatter with sea salt flakes and serve immediately.
notes: Pairs perfectly with Lightning-quick Tuna Linguine (p.48), Sumac Chicken (p.87) and Tomatoey Lamb Chickpea Bake (p.91).
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
